description: Extensive network of overhead trolleybus power lines, utility poles, wide asphalt road with white dashed and solid lane markings and yellow circular pavement markers, streetlights, distant multi-story building with a large rectangular billboard frame on its roof and other urban buildings, prominent light-colored building with multiple arched window openings on the right.

Distant hills with structures, clear sky, commercial buildings, tall dark streetlight with double arms, shorter dark streetlight with double arms, scattered trees and bushes, paved parking lot, black metal railing/fence, concrete ground.

Part of a white stucco building with a rectangular window, reddish-brown brick wall with a rectangular window, white stucco corner bay window with multiple panes, a teal rectangular sign displaying "LW GROCERY" in large white letters, a red Coca-Cola logo sign, smaller white text reading "FRUITS - VEGETABLES - BEER - WINE" on the teal sign, ground floor storefront windows, and lower signs for "GROCERY" and "LIQUOR" on the building's facade.
